scope: Correct the action-identifier example anchoring before completing the shared local comparison
researcher_repair: Replace all literal valid fact/order identifiers in output-format examples with descriptive type schemas, consistently in RxRSIAgent, Direct, SafeRx adaptation and the SkeMex common actor. This repair is not counted as RSI.
evidence_for_repair: On 48 training admissions, changing only example A1/A2 to A23/A24 shifts A23 selection from 5 to 46 cases. Descriptive schemas reduce A1 selection from 36 to 8 and raise training drug F1 from 3.57% to 7.57%; uncertainty is retained.
task: Admission +6h observations to the complete set of new/change orders in hours 6-12; fixed 24-candidate joint-order space, 128 normalized drug names
new_training: 144 different source-training admissions, positions 144:288, six rounds of 24; previous 144 admissions informed prior development
test_history: Earlier supervised and literal-schema test results have been observed. This is exploratory repeated-benchmark research, not a pristine confirmatory holdout.
learning: A local reflector receives actual selected training traces, observed/reference discrepancies, checked facts, evidence and rejected-edit history; it proposes a conditional procedure and bounded fact scope, or no edit.
promotion: Strict proposal mean(drug F1, Core4 F1) improvement and no decrease in either guard endpoint; no test score chooses a state.
